name: gemini-lanhu
description: Lanhu (蓝湖) MCP integration for UI design inspection, element style extraction, and slice export tailored for Qt/QML development.
instructions: Use these tools to inspect Lanhu (蓝湖) design files, search for layers and UI elements, extract QML-friendly properties (x, y, width, height, colors, fonts, borders, radius), and download slice assets directly into your project's assets/images directory.
